description: FloodForecaster supplies three HEC-RAS 6.5 projects with terrain, geometry, boundary conditions and 22 base hydrographs each for domain-adaptation research. Documentation covers licensing, USGS terrain provenance and checksums. This resource is provided by Taghizadeh, Mehdi; Zandsalimi, Zanko; Nabian, Mohammad Amin and coauthors. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists CFF, MD, TXT, ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Provider checks are reported claims; this review did not reproduce byte comparisons or hydraulic runs. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
